summary: Created an LVM logical volume (vgdata/lvdata) on node1 backed by two loopback files (since the node has no spare block device), formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/data, wrote test data, then grew it online from ~1GB to 2.15GB via a second PV/vgextend/lvextend -r while remaining mounted with data intact. Set up a systemd oneshot unit (lvm-loop-setup.service) to reattach the loop devices at boot and an /etc/fstab entry for /srv/data, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and healthy state, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until it came back, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the LV, mount, and data (via sha256sum) all recovered correctly post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected disk layout on node1 (single vda1 partition, no spare disk)
Created loopback-backed files under /var/lib/lvm-backing and attached via losetup
Created PV/VG/LV (vgdata/lvdata), formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/data
Wrote test files and recorded sha256 checksums
Created systemd unit lvm-loop-setup.service to reattach loop devices at boot; added /etc/fstab entry for /srv/data
Added a second loopback PV, extended VG and LV, resized filesystem online (-r) to 2.15GiB while mounted
Verified mount, size, and data checksums post-grow
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, lvs/pvs, service enabled state)
Rebooted node1 via systemd-run + systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec was available again, confirmed changed boot_id
Verified post-restart recovery: loop devices reattached, VG/LV active, /srv/data mounted at correct size, checksums OK

evidence.summary: pvcreate/vgcreate/lvcreate succeeded; mkfs.ext4 and mount at /srv/data confirmed via df -h and lsblk

evidence.requirement: Grown to >=2GB while mounted, contents intact
evidence.summary: lvextend -L 2200M -r performed online resize while /srv/data stayed mounted; df -h shows 2.1G and sha256sum -c confirms testfile.txt and blob.bin checksums unchanged
Captured boot_id dbb46974-... plus lvs/pvs output and enabled lvm-loop-setup.service showing healthy LVM state before reboot
systemd-run scheduled reboot and returned immediately; subsequent poll showed connection refused confirming the node actually went down
boot_id changed from dbb46974-b99f-4850-81d2-22dfbdf7b8ed to 6a1b24f6-4f6b-427f-ac7a-4604d55a3ede after node came back online

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of LV, mount, and data
evidence.summary: After reboot, lvm-loop-setup.service ran and reattached both loop devices, vgdata/lvdata activated, /srv/data mounted at 2.1G, and sha256sum -c confirmed both test files intact
